description: Seismic station Prague - historical records is a dataset listed in EGDI Metadata Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoh.conterra. Historical seismograms from Prague seismic station. Non-continuous data stored on paper records since 1927 to the 1990s. Coverage: Europe. Its keywords include seismologie, CzechGeo, geofyzika, seismology, geophysics. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geology-cz.
